MIND. [1] [Cur.]
Indecision, no longer wishes to think and act for herself. θ Nervous debility.
Very much depressed about herself, desire only to shut herself up away from people. θ Nervous debility.
Despairing. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
Hydrophobia.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cur.]
Sharp sticking pains over right eye, extending backwards over right side of head. θ Nervous debility.
Vertical and frontal headache. θ Paralysis.
Occasional rush of blood to head. θ Nervous debility.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Cur.]
Head drawn backward, with stiffness of neck, swinging and trembling of hands. θ Headache.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cur.]
Eyes haggard, sunken. θ Nervous debility.
Black spots before vision (patient quite myopic), especially < from reading. θ Nervous debility.
Ptosis on right side.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Cur.]
Ozæna, with fetid lumps of pus, of six years standing.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Cur.]
Dull, anxious expression, with clay-colored skin. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
Aching of right side of face. θ Paralysis.
Facial and buccal paralysis ; in some cases with difficulty in swallowing.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cur.]
Tongue and mouth drawn to right side. θ Paralysis.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Cur.]
Dry mouth. θ Diabetes.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cur.]
Appetite variable. θ Paralysis.
Great thirst, especially evenings and at night. θ Diabetes.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cur.]
Hiccough frequent and annoying. θ Nervous debility.
Nausea in morning. θ Nervous debility. θ Paralysis.
Gastric troubles, nausea after eating, or in morning.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Cur.]
Rheumatic pain in pit of stomach, at times quite sharp, followed by nausea.
Shooting in stomach. θ Diabetes.
Digestive functions entirely prostrate, cannot bear anything on stomach, pyrosis, pain and distension after eating ever so little ; can eat only cornmeal mush and drink coffee. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Cur.]
Wearing ache from throat to left hip. θ Paralysis.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cur.]
Diarrhœa, with constant urging, fetid, thin, mush-like feces, excessive pain in hemorrhoidal tumors. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Cur.]
Ulcer of os uteri, funnel-shaped, upper diameter one inch ; whole neck of womb of a horny-like character, dark red, purplish, gnawed as if from mice all over surface of ulcer ; two small opaque pustules of size of pea on inner edge, containing in middle a translucent bloody fluid. Ichorous discharge, corroding, fetid ; indurations of abdominal parietes towards inguinal and ovarian regions, excessively painful to touch. Vaginal corrugations tumefied, reddish, inflamed ; very sensitive hemorrhoidal fissures and swelling of rectum and anus. General appearance of scirrhous cachexia. Digestive functions entirely prostrate.
Indolence, does not like to work or move about ; night sweats ; repugnance to sexual intercourse. θ Vaginitis.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Cur.]
Frequent hoarseness ; suffocating attacks, with sensation as if larynx were stopped up. θ Cough.
Burning and shooting in larynx ; hoarseness which occasions almost complete loss of voice. θ Cough.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Cur.]
Shortness of breath. θ Nervous debility.
Respiration difficult, stitching pains in right side. θ Cough.
Dyspnœa from weakness of respiratory motor nerves, as in phthisis and emphysema.
   

COUGH. [27] [Cur.]
Short, hacking cough, no expectoration, always dry, with soreness of walls of chest, < in damp weather, or laughing. θ Nervous debility.
Chronic cough, always troublesome in morning. θ Nervous debility.
Cough with white gelatinous expectoration. θ Paralysis.
Debility and cough, with free gray expectoration, in phthisical patient.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cur.]
Burning heat in chest with sensation of distension. θ Cough.
Severe pains in lungs, especially left ; sharp piercing pain through chest, always much < in damp weather ; shortness of breath ; chronic cough. θ Nervous debility.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Cur.]
Precordial anguish, with palpitation and stinging pains in heart. θ Cough.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Cur.]
Great soreness of chest, can hardly bear pressure of stethoscope. θ Nervous debility.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Cur.]
Dull, tired ache in shoulders and across back ; numb, tired pains up and down spine and in head. θ Nervous debility.
Pain in loins. Paralysis.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Cur.]
Complete paralysis of right deltoid muscle ; no pain ; after an apoplectic attack.
Pain and numbness on left side of chest and left arm ; tongue and mouth both drawn to right side ; both eyes and both ears fairly good ; grasp of left hand fair ; vertical and frontal headache ; right face aches at times ; fear of falling forward on rising ; nausea in morning ; appetite variable ; perspires with every exertion ; pain in loins ; prolapse of uterus for several years ; wearing ache from throat to left hip ; cough with white gelatinous expectoration.
Arms and fingers weak, as after a long illness ; arms become numb, and as if sprained or broken at elbows ; this pain extends to shoulders and across back a dull tired ache ; feeling as if heavy weights were hanging to arms ; same pains up and down spine and in head, numb tired pains ; similar pains in knees ; desire to stretch elbows, but muscles of arm are sore ; feeling along arm as if it had been burnt ; pains much < in damp weather. θ Nervous debility.
Leaden heaviness in arms, with increasing difficulty in playing piano. θ Nervous debility.
In evenings, arms and hands swollen, more painful and heavy. θ Nervous debility.
Great weakness especially of wrists and hands. θ Nervous debility.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Cur.]
Corns. θ Nervous debility.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Cur.]
Aching in all the limbs and body. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cur.]
Nervous Debility.
Debility of the aged, great failure of strength ; no cough, pain, or disordered digestion.
After being bitten by a dog suspected to be rabid, muscular restlessness, spasms, hydrophobia, and photophobia, and instead of the anguish she was in good humor ; (cured by injections, which were followed by symptoms of paralysis, from which patient had not entirely recovered even after a few months).
Pure paralysis ; nervous debility, from loss of fluids, or exhausting illness.
Double facial and right lateral paralysis (in consequence of repeated epileptic attacks), swallowing and articulation also affected.
Considerable general motor paralysis, no pain.
Paralysis from mechanical injury.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Cur.]
Nights restless, always desires to put feet out of bed, especially towards morning.
Cannot sleep late enough to obtain a good night's rest ; dreams of fire and of the business of the day ; < from lying long in bed, must get up as her feet and back ache. θ Nervous debility.
   

FEVER. [40] [Cur.]
Rigors at night, about 2 o'clock ; no more sleep ; some fever ; seldom moisture, except under arms. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
Perspires with every exertion. θ Paralysis.
